Hi Sara — welcome. I'll own the evidence intake for Redwood. To make the Vendr import smooth, please provide the following (I've attached a one-page checklist for quick reference):

Required for an initial profile import:
- SOC 2 attestation (PDF, redacted OK)
- Completed SIG matrix (XLSX) — thanks for sending the workbook
- CAIQ mapping: if you have a CAIQ export, include it; otherwise we can map SIG -> CAIQ on ingest
- SSO details: SAML metadata or OIDC discovery URL + test account (temp) if available
- Admin contact + technical contact 

Optional but helpful:
- Evidence presigned S3 links for large logs/ARTIFACTS (rotation proof, syslog samples)
- Short architecture diagram (PNG/PDF) for scoping network questions

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Upload options:
- Vendr profile link (preferred) — I'll provide the target profile id once you confirm upload method
- If you prefer an S3 presign, include the link in an email and we'll ingest it into Vendr

Operational notes:
- We typically retain uploaded artifacts in our evidence storage for 90 days for quick rechecks. If your legal team requires a different retention model, flag that now.
- For SOC2 redlines (if a customer requests a signed NDA or additional attestations), loop in Rishi and our legal ops.

If this looks good, please send the presign or confirm you'll upload to Vendr and I'll share the profile id.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security Operations Lead, Vendor Risk
Redwood Inference
